subject.title: Feishu: replied/quoted message mentions show as raw @_user_N placeholders

question: Should maintainers narrow/adopt https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/930 for this Feishu quoted-mention bug, or close that candidate and queue a fresh Feishu-only repair?
rationale: The source-level defect and fix boundary are clear, but an open conflicting fork PR already claims the issue with closing syntax, so duplicate automation should wait for maintainer ownership of that candidate path.

options.title: Narrow the fork PR
options.body: Adopt only the fetched-message mention parser and focused tests from the open fork candidate.

options.title: Queue a fresh repair
options.body: Close or ignore the fork candidate and let a new Feishu-only repair PR implement the parser/test fix from current main.

options.title: Leave owner-driven
options.body: Keep this issue for Feishu owners to fix with live workspace proof when they are ready.

recommendation.title: Narrow the fork PR
recommendation.body: Adopt only the fetched-message mention parser and focused tests from the open fork candidate.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is confined to the declared Feishu/Lark plugin ownership boundary.
